## Activity

During December 2024, Central Eye Clinic completed 191 captures. This activity represents the imaging work recorded for the month at the site. The reported capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. Overall activity is presented alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the results identified as referable.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 4 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.1. This measure indicates the proportion of the month’s captures that could not be graded from the available images. The result is reported with the activity total to support routine monitoring of image quality at Central Eye Clinic.

## Grading

A total of 49 results were graded referable during December 2024. The median grading lag was 13. This is the midpoint of the reported grading wait for the month. The referable result count and median lag are provided together to describe both the grading outcome and the time taken for results to be processed. These figures form the monthly operational record for Central Eye Clinic.
